Description: Architectural plans for a 25-unit residential development in Ōtāhuhu. The scheme arranges attached, multi-level homes around the site, with ground-level garaging, upper-level living accommodation and a contemporary mix of light, dark and timber-toned exterior cladding. The drawings include floor layouts, elevations and overall site planning for Units 1–25.
Features: 25 planned units; multi-level terrace-style layout; ground-level garaging; contemporary exterior cladding

Description: Architectural plans for three attached, two-storey residential dwellings identified as proposed Lots 1–3. Each home includes three bedrooms on the upper floor, with ground-floor living areas and integral garaging shown in the plans. The proposed façade combines weatherboard-style cladding with contrasting vertical panels.
Features: 3 planned homes (Lots 1–3); 3 bedrooms per dwelling; 2 storeys; integral garages
Verification note: Drawings name Pahland Developments Limited as the client; verify Sunshine Homes’ project role.

Description: Architectural plans for a substantial lifestyle residence on a sloping Flat Bush site. The two-level design provides seven bedrooms across multiple wings, generous living and dining spaces, outdoor deck areas, a swimming pool and spa, and a proposed lift. The drawings record approximately 863.35 m² of combined ground-floor and first-floor area.
Features: 7 bedrooms; approx. 863.35 m² planned total floor area; swimming pool and spa; lift; outdoor decks

Description: Architectural plans for a purpose-designed two-storey boarding house in Balmoral. The proposal contains ten bedrooms, including an accessible bedroom on the ground floor, together with communal kitchen, dining and living areas and a manager’s office. The drawings identify a total floor area of approximately 354.9 m².
Features: 10 bedrooms; 2 storeys; accessible ground-floor accommodation; communal kitchen/dining/living; approx. 354.9 m² floor area

Description: Architectural plans for a two-storey visitor-accommodation building in Papatoetoe. The layout provides fourteen bedrooms, including two accessible ground-floor bedrooms, alongside a reception area, communal lounge, kitchen and dining space. The design incorporates a brick-clad ground floor and contrasting dark vertical cladding above.
Features: 14 bedrooms; 2 storeys; 2 accessible ground-floor bedrooms; shared lounge, reception, kitchen and dining
